description: Country and destination metadata used by configurable risk rules. Not a legal determination of any embargo or sanctions program.

US_EMBARGO.label: Countries subject to comprehensive U.S. embargo programs
US_EMBARGO.note: Destinations in this group trigger legal review. Whether a transaction is authorized depends on the applicable program and current regulations.

SPECIAL_ATTENTION.label: Countries warranting special attention
SPECIAL_ATTENTION.note: This group reflects heightened regulatory attention, transshipment or diversion concerns, and is configurable.

country_notes.CN: China is included in the special-attention group. Chinese-origin foreign-produced items frequently raise U.S. content and Foreign Direct Product questions.
country_notes.SG: Singapore is a common transshipment and distribution hub. Verify the ultimate destination and end user when goods are routed through Singapore.
country_notes.HK: Hong Kong is included in the special-attention group.
country_notes.US: Transactions involving U.S.-origin items may be subject to the EAR.
country_notes.RU: Russia is included in the special-attention group and is subject to extensive sanctions and export-control restrictions.
country_notes.BY: Belarus is included in the special-attention group.
country_notes.IR: Iran is subject to a comprehensive U.S. embargo program.
country_notes.KP: North Korea is subject to a comprehensive U.S. embargo program.
country_notes.SY: Syria is subject to a comprehensive U.S. embargo program.
country_notes.CU: Cuba is subject to a comprehensive U.S. embargo program.
country_notes.UA: Ukraine is included in the special-attention group due to regional conflict-related controls.
